# pdf-lib 1.17.1

MIT licensed browser UMD distribution, copied without modification from the
bundled `pdf-lib@1.17.1` package. License: `LICENSE.md`.
Upstream: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib

Used locally to embed the same high-resolution page images shown in the patient
PDF preview. No CDN, external PDF conversion service, patient data transmission,
or backend contract change.
